findings.current: اس ٹنل کا سرٹیفکیٹ مسترد ہو گیا۔ ٹنل کا دکھایا ہوا {scheme} پتہ استعمال کریں، ایسی ٹنل منتخب کریں جس کے سرٹیفکیٹ پر فون بھروسا کرے، یا اپنی چلائی ہوئی ٹنل کا خود دستخط شدہ سرٹیفکیٹ بدل دیں — ایپ یہ جانچ نہیں چھوڑے گی۔
findings.problem: {scheme}='https://' is followed by a space and Urdu «پتہ». Under the UBA the neutrals '://' sit between L (https) and AL, so they take the RTL paragraph direction and render as '//:https' — the exact reorder the ur bidi-control exception records for http:// (bidi-controls.test.ts header). Controls are banned here, and {scheme} is not isolated at the call site (tunnel-verdict.ts:150, Alert body without dir). The reader is told to use the scheme they then see reversed.
findings.suggested: اس ٹنل کا سرٹیفکیٹ مسترد ہو گیا۔ ٹنل کا دکھایا ہوا {scheme} URL استعمال کریں، ایسی ٹنل منتخب کریں جس کے سرٹیفکیٹ پر فون بھروسا کرے، یا اپنی چلائی ہوئی ٹنل کا خود دستخط شدہ سرٹیفکیٹ بدل دیں — ایپ یہ جانچ نہیں چھوڑے گی۔
findings.why_fix_works: 'https:// URL' keeps the neutrals between two L runs, so they resolve L; same shape as cloudflare_note/ngrok_note, which are clean, and URL is the catalogue's term in verdict_unreachable.

findings.current: … ترتیبات → رازداری اور سیکیورٹی → مقامی نیٹ ورک …
findings.problem: U+2192 is bidi class ON and Bidi_Mirrored=No. In the RTL paragraph ترتیبات sits rightmost and each → points right, back at the item before it, so the arrows show the path backwards. This is the 'arrow mirrored wrongly' class from the RTL checklist. Apple's English source uses '>', which is mirrored; '→' is not.
findings.suggested: … ترتیبات ← رازداری اور سیکیورٹی ← مقامی نیٹ ورک میں Local Operator کو اجازت دیں، پھر “{action}” پر ٹیپ کریں۔
findings.note: iOS 26 added Urdu as a system language (source: netmag.pk, found by web search; the auditor has not checked it on a device). The three labels are plausible, but nobody has checked them against an Urdu iOS UI, so check them on a device. This does not gate.

findings.current: … اور اسے آپ کی کی چین میں رکھتی ہے۔
findings.problem: «آپ کی کی چین»: the genitive particle کی is directly followed by کی (key), so the phrase reads as a stutter and parses ambiguously. The auditor found no Urdu macOS UI term to match, so Apple's own Latin name is the recognisable choice, as with macOS in the same sentence.

code_findings.severity: MAJOR (code, not translation; does not gate this locale's translation verdict)
code_findings.problem: This is the only Latin-initial value of the 41. {detail} is English server text, so dir=auto or natural resolves the paragraph LTR, and «۔ اس کمپیوٹر پر چلائیں:» then lands in the wrong place. There are three render sites and none spreads useComposedDir: own-tunnel.tsx:572 (VerdictBlock → Alert), own-tunnel-settings.tsx:138 and :237 (Alert). The Alert body Text (alert.tsx:100) takes no dir. The translation is correct and must keep {detail} first, because a prefix would invent copy. Fix: give the Alert a dir or labelDir pass-through from useComposedDir() at those three sites, and add offline_detail to the Q-02 Latin-initial premise in ur-latin-initial-sites.test.ts.

rulings_on_translator_flags.verdict_local_network_ios arrows: Change → to ←; see URS2B1-02. → is not bidi-mirrored, so it points backwards in an RTL paragraph.
rulings_on_translator_flags.کی چین (keychain): Replace it with Latin 'Keychain'; see URS2B1-03. The transliteration collides with the genitive کی, and no Urdu Apple term for keychain was found.
rulings_on_translator_flags.ماخذ (origin): Accept it. ماخذ = source/origin, and the Latin '(origin)' gloss pins the web sense. The brackets resolve RTL by UBA N0 because the context before them is AL, so they mirror correctly. The meaning matches the trap: «کسی دوسرے ماخذ (origin) سے آنے والی ہر درخواست مسترد کرتا ہے» = refuses requests from any other origin.
rulings_on_translator_flags.کاپی کریں / ترمیم کریں widths: Keep both. These are estimates, not measurements: Figtree has no Arabic glyphs, so a system Arabic or Nastaliq fallback font draws them. At about 15 pt each label is roughly 55–70 pt plus 24 pt padding, so about 80–95 pt, against about 55 pt for 'Copy'. Both rows are flex-wrap (command-block.tsx:55; own-tunnel-settings.tsx button row), so they wrap rather than clip. «کاپی کریں» and «کاپی ہو گیا» are nearly the same width, so the copied-state swap barely reflows. The bare «کاپی» would grow by about 2x on press. The …کریں form is the catalogue convention (محفوظ کریں، منسوخ کریں، استعمال کریں). Shorter forms are not better. Check the Nastaliq line height on a device.
rulings_on_translator_flags.verdict_offline_detail Latin-initial: Keep the translation. The fix belongs at the render site; see URS2B1-C1.
rulings_on_translator_flags.install_note 'portal password' → ریلے کا: Accept it. It is the relay password, which is the catalogue term.
rulings_on_translator_flags.verdict_local_network دبائیں vs _ios ٹیپ: Accept it. The iOS-only verb appears only on the _ios key.
